title: Ask a trainer is listed as behind a switch, but live it is no longer offered at all
what: The feature list says members on a paid gym plan can ask a trainer a question from Message your gym. Since the newer 'pick who reads it' part is live on the gym database, the app hides the separate trainer side whenever the gym's list of people loads. It only comes back when that list fails to load. So no member sees Ask a trainer in normal use, and the map counts it as a working, switched feature.
expected: The map and the app agree: either Ask a trainer is marked as replaced by picking a trainer in Message your gym, or it is still offered where it is meant to be.
fix_line: Mark Ask a trainer as replaced in the feature list, or remove its old side from the app
